texts: On day 0 of Year 1, the night of the autumn equinox was clear and mild.
Keepers counted about twenty-five nightmoths at each lantern of the Cliff Path.
A crowd of nightmoths gathered at the East Row.
Three sky-cats descended from the cliff-spires.
The three sky-cats hunted the nightmoth crowd at the East Row.
The nightmoth crowd at the East Row shrank.
Keepers counted seven of the nightmoths at the East Row at the third watch.
The surviving nightmoths fled to the Hollows.
The surviving nightmoths reached the Hollows.

parse: (: s2_rule (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (PartOf $x cliff_path)) (And (Member (sk_count $x) count) (Agent (sk_count $x) sk_keepers_1) (Theme (sk_count $x) (sk_moths $x)) (GroupOf (sk_moths $x) nightmoth) (Cardinality (sk_moths $x) (ParticleFromNormal 25 2.5)) (Location (sk_count $x) $x) (Past (sk_count $x)))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "reached the Hollows" has a bare direct object, so it takes Theme (the instruction set's own worked example gives reach a Theme object); Goal is the oblique for a "to"-PP, which this clause does not contain.
The per-member reach rule repeats the same Goal-for-Theme role error inside its conclusion.
Cardinality's magnitude slot is specified as a native integer, but the rule puts a ParticleFromNormal distribution there for "about twenty-five".
"Some nightmoths survived the hunt" gets no per-member distribution rule even though survive is distributive and the parse emits such a rule for descend, hunt, flee and reach.
"at the East Row" in sentence 7 yields no atom at all (no Location on the counting event), while the parallel phrase in sentence 6 does produce a position atom.

q2_gaps: approximate cardinal count of a group ("about twenty-five nightmoths"): Cardinality takes a native integer, CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost take a bound, and CardinalityPhrase takes a vague-lexicon word, so a hedged exact numeral has no licensed form; ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure-family and Time value slots
review.notes: Naming, group/partitive and copular-with-time-modifier handling are otherwise correct, including the Name-only treatment of "the Hollows". Reading "the night of the autumn equinox" as Possession is a defensible default, but the instruction set does not really address a temporal-identification of-phrase.

issues.reason: "reached the Hollows" is a bare direct object and the direct-object roles are for objects the verb takes without a preposition, while Goal is defined as the "to …" oblique; the instruction set's own worked example "Sara reached the platform" gives reach a Theme.
The per-member rule's conclusion carries the same unlicensed (Goal (sk_reach $x) hollows), so the role error is replicated to every derived member event.

Cardinality's count slot is specified as a native integer, and ParticleFromNormal is licensed only as a Measure-family magnitude or a Time term's value, so (Cardinality (sk_moths $x) (ParticleFromNormal 25 2.5)) is ill-typed per the vocabulary — the calibration line makes an ill-typed atom a defect even in gap territory.

Quantifiers, generics & scope states that the same rule form distributes a distributive predicate over a plural or group ("the dogs barked"), and survive is not one of the reciprocal/aggregate predicates that stay group-only, so the per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_survivors_1) is determined, not optional.

It is correct that the sentence-7 PP yields no atom of its own, but the claim of lost content overstates: the parse takes the licensed NP-attachment reading ("seven of the nightmoths at the East Row"), and the restriction is already carried by (SubsetOf sk_subset_1 sk_crowd_1) over a crowd the parse has already placed with (LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 east_row).

gaps_confirmed: a hedged exact count ("about twenty-five nightmoths") has no licensed carrier: Cardinality takes a native integer, CardinalityAtLeast/AtMost take a bound the hedge does not state, and CardinalityPhrase takes a canonical vague-lexicon word
new_gaps: an epoch-relative / day-index calendar ("on day 0 of Year 1"): the Time section's (Day <n>) term is a within-month granularity sitting beside Month/Year, so a day counted off a fictional epoch has no distinct term and will not interoperate with the seeded day/month ordering rules

a temporal-identification of-phrase ("the night of the autumn equinox"): the of-phrase names which night, not a possessor or a nominalization's object, so the loose-association Possession is the only fallback head and it records an association the text states only as identification
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form for "reached the Hollows" is (Theme sk_reach_1 hollows); the per-member rule's conclusion likewise needs (Theme (sk_reach $x) hollows); for "about twenty-five" the instruction set licenses NO form that carries a hedged count, so the compliant parse emits the Skolem group and its GroupOf with no count atom at all and records the gap; and the survive clause needs the per-member rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_survivors_1) (And (Member (sk_survive $x) survive) (Agent (sk_survive $x) $x) (Theme (sk_survive $x) sk_hunt_1) (Past (sk_survive $x)))) at (STV 1.0 0.9) beside the group event.
adjudication.notes: Naming (Cliff Path / East Row typed-plus-Name, the Hollows Name-only), the s7 partitive, the s1 copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit and the collective/distributive split for gather and shrink are all handled correctly. The Goal-vs-Theme and the missing survive rule are both consistency failures against choices the same parse makes elsewhere.
